title: Four Buyers in Five Go Home Empty
subtitle: Gasoline volumes sold on the exchange covered only 18.1% of solvent demand, leaving most buyers unable to obtain fuel even when they had funds available.

source.name: Saint Petersburg International Mercantile Exchange demand coverage in the weekly source text

data.label: Demand served
data.annotation: A little over 10,000 tons per day changed hands.

data.label: Demand unmet
data.annotation: Roughly 45,000 tons of solvent daily demand remained unfilled.

supportingFacts.label: Approximate gasoline volume actually sold on the exchange.
Approximate demand left unmet after the available volume was allocated.

metadata.keyFinding: Only 18.1% of solvent gasoline demand was served.
